angle_source.note: 简报要求的第一人称 Baker Gu 叙述：做不到，不替真人编亲身经历（客户红线）；本片无旁白，质检的口吻标记按误报处理；PM 若给 Baker 认可的稿再做。

copy.caption: Full day-by-day itinerary in the first comment. Eighteen days along the Silk Road, from Xi'an through Jiayuguan, Dunhuang and Turpan to Urumqi. International and domestic flights, 4-5 star hotels, an English-speaking tour guide and the 38 meals listed in the itinerary are included. Travel insurance is not included.
